author: Galvanox
body:
So its been near to two years since I was banned, and I was also banned from mineplex on just this same reason, and I found myself being unbanned and enjoying being a donor there. Now, over here, I want to stretch my luck, it has truly been a long time, and I think I have left all I would think of cheating, I began to understand that cheating is not fun, it just ruins the fun for others.

It has been a very long time that I played on this server, and I loved it, I spent so much time with my friends that I would love to come back. I have grown out of my old ways by now, and hope I can get back on the server, it seems to have grown quite much and I hope to be a part of your community again.
